mission: Find 1 US B2B software company with a current declared 11–50 employee band and an open Account Executive posting dated within 30 days.

eligibility.industry: Verified product, business customers and business activity; broad provider industry categories alone never prove software.
eligibility.size: Declared band from a current company record; associated-member counts are not staff counts. Exact counts and partially overlapping bands stay UNKNOWN.
eligibility.geography: Verified US company headquarters, not just a US job location.
eligibility.hiring: Dated, currently open Account Executive posting for this same employer, not recruitment on behalf of a client.
eligibility.unknown: Never MATCH; missing evidence alone never proves NON_MATCH.
eligibility.funding: No funding requirement or purchases. No broadening or skipped mandatory verification.

accounting.committed_estimates: Approved template maxima, including pending and uncertain operations; never refunded, never free after checkpoint loss.
accounting.actual_costs: Separate, nullable until an auditable provider receipt. The largest reported charge is kept; an over-quote charge stops the authorization.
accounting.adoption: No new purchase; every status/dataset/receipt transport read is its own poll admission with an admitted parent.
accounting.refusal: No transport, no automatic re-buy, no fallback that bypasses the refused authorization.
accounting.counts: Failed/uncertain starts retain their slots. A new worker, new slice or telemetry drain does not reset the authorization; only an administrator can authorize a new queue row.

first_smoke_profile.why: The company's own record is the qualification evidence, so the smoke buys the job search (whose rows carry the employer's LinkedIn record and declared band) and one company-details lookup of that employer. Five reads, allocated 3 + 2 by the reads template, cover both runs: the final run's receipt is deferred to the durable reconciliation (#96). Firecrawl's variable credits cannot yet be bounded or receipted.
first_smoke_profile.apify_vendor_cap: maxTotalChargeUsd on every start, never above the template maximum (set by the gate)

reads.job_search: 1-2 long-polled status reads (waitForFinish <= 60 s) + 1 settled receipt (deferred if two status reads were needed) + 1 dataset
reads.company_details: 1 long-polled status read + 1 dataset; its receipt is deferred
reads.reconciliation: scripts/test-project/smoke-reconciliation.sql lists every open purchase; reconcile_discovery_smoke_operation closes it, and until then no later smoke can be authorized or spend

models.orchestration: LEAD_V2_SMOKE_ORCHESTRATION=minimal: execution plan, batch evaluation, mission evaluation, opportunity reasoning
